name: Dyna Taku Parody
description: Personal MuJoCo/WASM sim of Dyna's Taku (with permission)

paragraphs: 个人作品（parody），经 DYNA Robotics 同意后发布，基于 dyna.co 公开内容制作；并非 DYNA Robotics 官方作品。 A personal work (parody), released with DYNA Robotics' permission and built from dyna.co's public content; not an official DYNA Robotics product.
在浏览器里实时运行的 Taku 半人形机器人物理仿真：MuJoCo 3.14（WebAssembly，跑在 Web Worker 里）+ three.js 渲染， 全部在你的电脑上计算，没有服务器端。

A real-time physics simulation of the Taku semi-humanoid, entirely in your browser: MuJoCo 3.14 (WebAssembly, in a Web Worker) rendered with three.js, computed on your own machine with no server side.
features: 驾驶 / Drive: WASD 移动、QE 转向（或屏幕方向盘）· WASD to move, QE to turn (or the on-screen pad)
关节与夹爪滑块、姿态预设 · joint and gripper sliders, pose presets
回放 Dyna 的真机遥操作片段（洗衣房里取烘干机衣物，物理闭环时门和推车靠手真正推动，纯运动学则完全按录制）
浏览器里实时运行的 RL 全身控制器，可拖动双手遥操作 · a live RL whole-body controller with drag-the-hands teleop
